section1.title: Our Application
section1.content: Star Trek Explorer is a comprehensive search application that allows you to explore the vast universe of Star Trek characters and animals. Whether you're a dedicated Trekkie or just beginning your journey through the final frontier, our app provides an intuitive way to discover and learn about the diverse creatures that inhabit the Star Trek universe.

section2.title: Powered by STAPI
section2.content2: — the first public RESTful API dedicated to Star Trek data. STAPI provides access to a comprehensive database of Star Trek lore, including characters, species, animals, and much more from across all Star Trek series and movies.

section3.title: Key Features
section3.feature1: Real-time search across thousands of Star Trek animals and creatures
section3.feature2: Detailed information cards with species classification
section3.feature3: Fast and efficient pagination for browsing large datasets

section4.title: Development
section4.content1: This application was built as part of the
section4.content2: — a free, community-based education program conducted by The Rolling Scopes Community. The course covers modern React development practices, including TypeScript, routing, state management, and testing.

section5.title: Author
section5.content: Developed with passion for both Star Trek and modern web technologies.
